title: Deep Clone Strategies — Runnable Implementations
title_es: Estrategias de deep clone — Implementaciones ejecutables
description: Runnable deep clone comparison in three languages (Python, JavaScript, Java): a JSON round-trip that silently loses types versus a proper deep clone that preserves dates, sets, maps, and circular references.
description_es: Comparación ejecutable de deep clone en tres lenguajes (Python, JavaScript, Java): un round-trip JSON que pierde tipos en silencio frente a un clonado profundo real que preserva fechas, sets, mapas y referencias circulares.
